'''TK 329''' was a male [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. TK 329 was being very open about his experiences with the Empire while he was perpetuating Imperial propaganda.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The dead. They...|TK 329's last words before succumbing to the illness|<ref name="Death tweet">{{Twitter|TK329|status/4837834512|Stormtrooper TK 329|quote=The dead. They...|date=2009-10-13|archivedate=20211101042131}}</ref>}}
TK 329 was stationed on board the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]. At one point in his career, he was under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tallos]], but sometimes joined Commander [[Gorrister]] and his squad during training activities. TK 329 has a wife named [[Mera]] and a son named [[Gareth (TK 329's son)|Gareth]]. When TK 329 trained at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], he finished at the top of his class. During his time at the academy, he became friends with a man named [[Davin (Human)|Davin]]. TK 329 first encountered the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] when a group of them ambushed his squad on a peacekeeping mission to the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

[[File:Trooperlogo.jpg|thumb|The insignia used by TK 329]]

During TK 329's service aboard the ''Vector'', he and the rest of the crew had some R&R while a small team was deployed planetside on [[Meglumine]]. After their stop, TK 329 started hearing rumors that a group of troops had mishandled special cargo and some of it got contaminated. After that they had problems with the engines. The crew had to switch to backup power twice in three days to keep the engines going. The engines eventually stalled and the communications malfunctioned.

Suddenly, a lot more men than usual were checking in to the sickbays. The infection started to show as the training sessions were canceled because there were not enough participants. TK 329 got checked out at the infirmary and saw that the earliest victims of the illness did not make it. Later, the death toll reached hundreds, and TK 329 remarked that the effects of the illness were horrific.

Eventually, the ''Vector'' lost all power and had to rely on the back-up generators for the most minimal of [[Life support/Legends|life support]]. The troopers that hadn't been infected began talking about making an escape. The halls were stained with blood, and decay filled the air. TK 329 sent a message to his wife and child, telling them he was sorry and he loved them.

TK 329 planned to join Commander [[Gorrister]] and his team, who were planning an escape. However, before he could, he began feeling the effects of the sickness and realised that he was dying. As TK 329 died, he sent a final message implying that he was witnessing a reanimation caused by the virus, but was unable to finish the message before succumbing to his sickness.

==Personality and traits==
TK 329 thought that the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] was one of the best weapons on the market. TK 329 thought that the ''Vector'' was a marvel of engineering and that one did not know the size of a vessel until one was forced to run the length of the halls for morning drills. He also thought that [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were better than [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] because they had to fight and train their whole lives for the opportunity to serve. TK 329 believed that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] way was one of cowardice and selfishness and that they would not rest until [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was torn apart in civil unrest. TK 329 said that to be in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], you should think yourself lucky. TK 329 eventually wished to finish his service and become one of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]]. He also wished that his son would follow in his footsteps. TK 329 expressed that even the weak could be of use to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
